Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 47  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer’s step 47 is the first clear mistake because it failed to follow the instruction to search the Ensembl Genome Browser and instead stayed on NCBI Genome Data Viewer, merely typing “beluga whale” into NCBI’s search box. That meant it never actually checked Ensembl for the beluga whale GFF3 file, which is critical because the final answer turned out to be an NCBI GDV link that needed proper validation. This misstep directly contributed to the wrong final solution, since the conversation ended with a link that was not reliably established as the “most recent one on 20/10/2020.”
